newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index soars 4.34 pct at close.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index soars 4.34 pct at close.

text.p: The Philippine stock market main index ended 112.71 points higher, or 4.34 percent, to 2,710.91 points on modest volume, posting the second biggest single-day rise for the year on across-the-board buying, traders said.
"I guess people must have realised what we have been saying all along, that the market is oversold," said Luz Lorenzo, research head at Peregrine Securities.
Thirdliner issues hogged the limelight early in the session but in late trade blue chips led by Ayala Land Inc, Petron Corp and Meralco B were bought up.
Although turnover was higher at 2.08 billion pesos compared to the 1.89 billion the previous session, it was still lower than the average daily transaction of 2.7 billion pesos to 2.9 billion.
In the broad market, gainers clobbered losers 125 to 22 with 39 issues unchanged.
All indices rose with the badly hit property index posting the biggest gain by 4.30 percent, closing at 1,290.53 points.

"This maybe an indication that soon there may be a reversal. I'm not saying there is already a reversal just an indication that people are gaining confidence," said Ramon Adviento, analyst at Sun Hung Kai Securities.
Philippine TA Securities, however, said that market may see some pullback on Wednesday due to the steep rise and ahead of the release of first quarter GNP data.
